name: Team prototype grid
status: The grid as it is in the game build (team exports, 2026-09-23). The team's current baseline.
notes: No amounts and no tags: options are listed, quantities live in the team sheet (data/team_sheet/UE_ResourcesMerged.tsv: Amount1..3 for slots 1..3 at the best grade, Result Amount = units made).

madeIn.grade comes from the team sheet (UE_BuildingsFunctional: ProducesHighEfficiency = 3, Mid = 2, Low = 1). Grade 3 = fewest inputs, shortest time; grade 2 uses x1.4 inputs, grade 1 x1.8 (game settings).
A recipe slot is filled by ONE of its options. A building cost slot likewise.
